UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account profile for KinoFrame Studio.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

username.description: Unique lowercase studio handle (3-24 chars) or empty string before claimed.

photoURL.description: Profile avatar URL or empty string.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when account record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when account record was last updated.

UsernameClaim.title: UsernameClaim
UsernameClaim.description: Non-PII unique handle ownership record preventing duplicate usernames.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the handle owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when handle was claimed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when handle record was written.

StudioProject.title: StudioProject
StudioProject.description: Saved KinoFrame video sequence and photo grading project.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the project creator and sole owner.

mode.description: Primary studio workspace for this project.

beatBpm.description: Beat grid tempo in beats per minute (40-240).

clipCount.description: Number of timeline clips in Track V1.

totalDuration.description: Total timeline sequence duration in seconds.

clips.description: Ordered list of Track V1 clips with keyframes, transitions, and EditDocument maps including shape masks (max 60).

globalOverlays.description: List of Track T1 keyframed text, sticker, and mask overlay maps (max 40).

audioClips.description: List of Track A1 audio clip reference maps (max 20).

photoEdits.description: Map of assetId to Photo Lab EditDocument grading and masking settings (max 30 entries).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when project was first saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when project was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated user account profiles containing email, display details, and optional unique username.

/usernames/{username}.description: Zero-PII unique handle registry enforcing global case-insensitive username uniqueness.

/projects/{projectId}.description: Saved KinoFrame video and photo editing projects isolated to ownerId.
